title: Qualify per-Photo status by immutable admission lineage

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Photo processing API compatibility tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/inventory/test_photo_processing_api.py

verify.summary: Fresh independent T2 verification on the exact packaged image passed the immutable admission-lineage probe, the complete five-test API contract suite, mypy and mb-lint. It proved exact composite-key A selection across the A-only/A+B by A-serving/B-serving matrix, ignored pending/ready/multiple later revisions, preserved exact A fields, derived only searchable=false under B serving, retained missing-A 5xx, and executed SELECT-only with complete cleanup.

evidence_required: .memory-bank/contracts/photo-processing-api.md#admission-lineage-selector RED: a valid A-admitted Photo with an additional B state reaches the unqualified multi-row query and HTTP 500; GREEN: the inventory boundary passes immutable admission revision A, preserves A's ordinary completeness/activity searchable truth while A serves, and returns exact A fields with searchable=false after serving changes to B even when B is complete ready; decisive comparison: response identity/status/timestamps match A, B remains ignored, owner rows are unchanged and missing A retains the existing 5xx branch; artifact: isolated A+B API/database matrix and SELECT-only projection output.
purpose: Repair the existing per-Photo processing read so every accepted Photo selects its immutable admission state explicitly when later revision rows exist.
success_outcome: An A-admitted Photo with any later B state returns one exact A status response instead of a multiple-row 500, while current-serving compatibility keeps the selected A state non-searchable after the switch.
anti_goals: Do not change the response schema, authentication, authorization, uploader UI or accepted processing lifecycle.
Do not select by current serving revision, row order, timestamps, status or attempt count, and do not add fallback/history/registry state.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
Changes to staff roles, endpoint schema or processing-owned state
stop_conditions: The immutable admission revision cannot qualify the existing processing read without changing the public schema or ownership edge.
Correctness would require current-serving fallback, inferred row ordering or another lifecycle mechanism.

constraints: Inventory passes Photo.admission_pipeline_revision_id through the existing public processing read; processing filters the exact composite-key state.
Use disposable A and B revisions plus one A-admitted Photo, safe repeat and owner-bounded cleanup.
Keep the existing 401/403/404/422/5xx mapping and protected-value redaction unchanged.
invariants: All state-bearing response fields come from the immutable admission revision.
A later B row never replaces or multiplies the response, and the selected A state is not searchable while B serves.
The read performs no processing or inventory state mutation.
verification_targets: A+B integration proof covers A-current completeness/activity truth and the serving switch with absent, pending and complete-ready B states; every B-current case returns exact A fields with searchable=false and no MultipleResultsFound.
Static and database tracing proves explicit admission-revision qualification, SELECT-only behavior, unchanged auth/error/redaction semantics and complete disposable cleanup.
